cwloadout-desc: Adds loadout functionality to CreateWiki, allowing wikis to be created with pre-populated content from XML dumps and additional extensions/settings.
cwloadout-help-loadout: Select your preferred loadout. By default, wikis are created with only a main page, which is ideal if you want to start from scratch or import content from another wiki. Selecting another loadout will add some basic templates/extensions to your wiki.
cwloadout-label-loadout-none: Minimal wiki (no templates, only a main page)
